sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar for the second day of Rosh Hashanah 5741.

translations.translation: B”SD.
Monday of Rosh Hashanah, 5741*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that on Rosh Hashanah, the revelation of G‑dliness reaches the level of “zeh,” which began with the creation of Adam, establishing Rosh Hashanah as the beginning of G‑d’s works.

translations.translation: “This day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day.”
And it is known that “the day”
(unspecified)
refers to Rosh Hashanah.
And the explanation of “this day” is that on the day of Rosh Hashanah, the aspect of “this” is drawn down,
for on Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish people crown the Holy One, blessed be He, as King,
and they effect and bring about the revelation of His sovereignty, blessed be He, throughout the entire world,
until “every creature shall know that You have made it,”
so that even the aspect of “the made” in Asiyah
(and certainly in Yetzirah and Beriah)
shall know that You have made it.
And this is “this day,”
for on Rosh Hashanah, G‑dliness is drawn down in actual revelation,
to the point of “this,”
as each person points with his finger and says “this.”
And it can be said that this is also the explanation of what we say about the day of Rosh Hashanah: “This day is the beginning of Your works,”
for the precise point in this is known from the holy words of the Alter Rebbe, the Mitteler Rebbe, the Tzemach Tzedek, the Rebbe Maharash, and the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, and the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Nasi of our generation,
that the world was created on the twenty-fifth of Elul,
and Rosh Hashanah is the day when Adam, the first man, was created, which is the sixth day of Creation,
so how can we say of this day that it is the beginning of Your works?
And also, why is Rosh Hashanah on the first of Tishrei and not on the twenty-fifth of Elul?
Furthermore, on Rosh Hashanah, “all inhabitants of the world pass before You like sheep,”
not only the category of the speaking being, but also the creations of the category of the living,
the category of the growing, and the category of the silent,
so why is Rosh Hashanah specifically on the day when man was created?
And the explanation of this is
that the ultimate purpose of the creation of the world is that man, through his service, should draw down a revelation of G‑dliness into the world,
a revelation to the level of “this”
(as each person points with his finger and says “this”),
and this matter was innovated and actualized on the day when man was created,
for the creation of the world on the twenty-fifth of Elul was in the aspect of “kah,”
and on the day when Adam, the first man, was created
(through his service)
a revelation of G‑dliness was innovated and actualized,
in the aspect of “zeh.”

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that understanding the superiority of the world as created on the first day of Creation clarifies the great elevation that was innovated on the day Adam was created, which is why the maamarim discuss the level of the twenty-fifth of Elul.

translations.translation: And the explanation of the elevation that was innovated and actualized on the day when Adam, the first man, was created, will be understood by prefacing the level of the world as it was created on the first day of Maaseh Bereishis
(on the twenty-fifth of Elul),
when the world was on a lofty level
(as will be explained),
from which the greatness of the elevation that was innovated and actualized in the world on the day when Adam, the first man, was created, will be understood.
And it can be said that this is the reason why in many discourses of our Nesi’im about Rosh Hashanah
(in which the reason why Rosh Hashanah is on the first of Tishrei is explained)
the superiority of the twenty-fifth of Elul is explained,
for through the explanation of the superiority of the twenty-fifth of Elul, the greatness of the elevation of Rosh Hashanah is better understood.
